```{r}
# ===== حِزم أساسية (بسيطة) =====
need <- c("data.table","ggplot2","limma","msigdbr","pheatmap","knitr","matrixStats","arrow")
inst <- need[!need %in% installed.packages()[,1]]
if(length(inst)) install.packages(inst, repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(limma)
  library(msigdbr); library(pheatmap); library(knitr)
  library(matrixStats); library(arrow)
})

# Bioconductor لـ GSVA الجديدة (Param API)
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly=TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
if (!requireNamespace("GSVA", quietly=TRUE)) BiocManager::install("GSVA", ask=FALSE, update=FALSE)
library(GSVA)
```

```{r}
# ===== Paths =====
source("R/workflow_utils.R")
cfg <- load_moda_paths()
base_dir <- cfg$external_project_dir
proc_dir <- cfg$external_processed_dir
results_root <- if (nzchar(cfg$external_results_dir)) cfg$external_results_dir else file.path(base_dir, "results")
res_fig  <- file.path(results_root,"figures"); dir.create(res_fig, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
res_tab  <- file.path(results_root,"tables");  dir.create(res_tab, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
res_sig  <- file.path(results_root,"signatures"); dir.create(res_sig, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)

# (اختياري) تنظيف قديم:
# unlink(list.files(res_tab, full.names=TRUE), force=TRUE)
# unlink(list.files(res_sig, full.names=TRUE), force=TRUE)

# ===== Load matrices (من Step02) =====
layers <- c("rna","proteome","phospho","mirna","methyl","acetyl")
mat_scaled <- setNames(vector("list", length(layers)), layers)
for (L in layers) {
  mat_scaled[[L]] <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, L, "scaled.rds"))
}
common_samples <- colnames(mat_scaled[[1]])

# ===== Clinical labels =====
meta <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir,"clinical","meta_labels.rds"))
meta <- meta[match(common_samples, meta$sample_id), , drop=FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(common_samples, meta$sample_id))  # تأكيد تطابق ترتيب العينات
```


```{r}
# ===== Utilities بسيطة =====
save_tbl <- function(df, name) write.csv(df, file.path(res_tab, name), row.names=FALSE)

volcano <- function(tt, title="Volcano", lfc=1, fdr=0.05){
  df <- data.frame(logFC=tt$logFC, FDR=tt$adj.P.Val)
  ggplot(df, aes(logFC, -log10(pmax(FDR,1e-300)))) +
    geom_point(size=0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc,lfc), linetype=2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(fdr), linetype=2) +
    labs(title=title, x="log2FC", y="-log10(FDR)")
}

run_limma <- function(m, group_vec){
  g <- factor(group_vec); stopifnot(length(levels(g))==2)
  design <- model.matrix(~0+g); colnames(design) <- levels(g)
  fit <- lmFit(m, design)
  cont <- makeContrasts(contrasts=paste0(levels(g)[2],"-",levels(g)[1]), levels=design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, cont))
  tt <- topTable(fit2, number=Inf, sort.by="P")
  tt$feature <- rownames(tt)
  tt
}

# ===== GSVA (Param API) — تغليف بسيط ومتوافق =====
filter_sets <- function(gslist, genes, min_size=10, max_size=1000){
  gs2 <- lapply(gslist, function(gs) intersect(gs, genes))
  lens <- vapply(gs2, length, integer(1))
  gs2[lens >= min_size & lens <= max_size]
}
prep_for_gsva <- function(m){
  m <- as.matrix(m); m[!is.finite(m)] <- NA
  keep <- rowSums(is.finite(m)) >= 2
  m <- m[keep,,drop=FALSE]
  m <- m[rowSds(m, na.rm=TRUE) > 0, , drop=FALSE]
  if (any(duplicated(rownames(m)))){
    idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(m)), rownames(m))
    m <- do.call(rbind, lapply(idx, function(ix) colMeans(m[ix,,drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)))
  }
  if (anyNA(m)){
    rm <- rowMeans(m, na.rm=TRUE); rows_na <- which(rowSums(is.na(m))>0)
    for (i in rows_na) m[i, is.na(m[i,])] <- rm[i]
  }
  m
}
.pick_args <- function(fun, args_list){
  fmls <- try(formals(fun), silent=TRUE); if (inherits(fmls,"try-error") || is.null(fmls)) return(list())
  args_list[intersect(names(args_list), names(fmls))]
}
.make_param <- function(method=c("gsva","ssgsea","zscore","plage"), m, gslist,
                        kcdf="Gaussian", min_size=10, max_size=1000, mx.diff=TRUE){
  method <- match.arg(method)
  m <- prep_for_gsva(m)
  gslist <- filter_sets(gslist, rownames(m), min_size, max_size)
  common_args <- list(
    exprData=m, expr=m,
    geneSets=gslist, gset.idx.list=gslist,
    kcdf=kcdf, minSize=min_size, maxSize=max_size,
    mxDiff=mx.diff, mx.diff=mx.diff
  )
  if (method=="gsva"){
    do.call(GSVA::gsvaParam, .pick_args(GSVA::gsvaParam, common_args))
  } else if (method=="ssgsea"){
    common_args$absRanking <- TRUE
    do.call(GSVA::ssgseaParam, .pick_args(GSVA::ssgseaParam, common_args))
  } else if (method=="zscore"){
    do.call(GSVA::zscoreParam, .pick_args(GSVA::zscoreParam, common_args))
  } else {
    do.call(GSVA::plageParam,  .pick_args(GSVA::plageParam,  common_args))
  }
}
run_gsva_param <- function(m, gslist, method=c("gsva","ssgsea","zscore","plage"),
                           min_size=10, max_size=1000){
  method <- match.arg(method)
  param <- .make_param(method, m, gslist, min_size=min_size, max_size=max_size)
  args <- list(param=param)
  if (requireNamespace("BiocParallel", quietly=TRUE) &&
      "BPPARAM" %in% names(formals(GSVA::gsva))){
    args$BPPARAM <- BiocParallel::SerialParam()
  }
  as.matrix(do.call(GSVA::gsva, args))
}
```

```{r}
stopifnot("type" %in% names(meta))
sel <- which(meta$type %in% c("NAT","Tumor"))
group <- droplevels(factor(meta$type[sel], levels=c("NAT","Tumor")))

results_de <- list(); sig_counts <- c()
for (L in layers){
  m <- mat_scaled[[L]][, sel, drop=FALSE]
  tt <- run_limma(m, group)
  results_de[[L]] <- tt
  save_tbl(tt, paste0("DE_", toupper(L), "_Tumor_vs_NAT.csv"))
  print(volcano(tt, title=paste(toupper(L),"• Tumor vs NAT")))
  sig_counts[L] <- sum(tt$adj.P.Val <= 0.05)
}
kable(data.frame(layer=names(sig_counts), n_sig_FDR_0.05=sig_counts),
      caption="عدد الميزات الدالّة (FDR≤0.05) — Tumor vs NAT")

```
```{r}
# Gene sets من msigdbr
hms <- msigdbr(species="Homo sapiens", category="H")[,c("gs_name","gene_symbol")]
react <- msigdbr(species="Homo sapiens", category="C2", subcategory="CP:REACTOME")[,c("gs_name","gene_symbol")]
to_list <- function(df) split(df$gene_symbol, df$gs_name)
gs_h <- to_list(hms); gs_r <- to_list(react)

# RNA scores
rna <- mat_scaled$rna
rna_gsva_h <- run_gsva_param(rna, gs_h, method="gsva",  min_size=10)
rna_gsva_r <- run_gsva_param(rna, gs_r, method="gsva",  min_size=10)
saveRDS(list(rna_h=rna_gsva_h, rna_react=rna_gsva_r), file.path(res_sig,"gsva_rna.rds"))

# Proteome (لو rownames رموز جينية)
prot <- mat_scaled$proteome
prot_gsva_h <- run_gsva_param(prot, gs_h, method="gsva", min_size=10)
saveRDS(prot_gsva_h, file.path(res_sig,"gsva_proteome_hallmark.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Boxplots لبعض المسارات
box_one <- function(scores, set_name, title){
  sc <- scores[set_name, , drop=TRUE]
  df <- data.frame(score=sc, group=meta$type[colnames(scores)])
  ggplot(df, aes(group, score)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.size=0.6) +
    labs(title=paste(title, "•", set_name), x=NULL, y="score")
}
print(box_one(rna_gsva_h, "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS", "RNA"))
print(box_one(rna_gsva_h, "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE", "RNA"))
```


```{r}
# اختار أعلى 30 مسار متغير
top_var <- head(order(matrixStats::rowVars(rna_gsva_h), decreasing = TRUE),
                min(30, nrow(rna_gsva_h)))

# ابني annotation صح باستخدام match على sample_id
samp <- colnames(rna_gsva_h)
ann_type <- meta$type[match(samp, meta$sample_id)]   # ← دي المهمة
# sanity check
table(ann_type, useNA = "ifany")

# حوّله لفـاكتر بمستويات مرتّبة
anno <- data.frame(type = factor(ann_type, levels = c("NAT","Tumor")))
rownames(anno) <- samp

# ألوان اختيارية (علشان يبقى واضح)
ann_cols <- list(type = c(NAT="#66bd63", Tumor="#ef3b2c"))

# ارسم
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  scale(t(rna_gsva_h[top_var, , drop = FALSE])),
  annotation_col   = anno,
  annotation_colors= ann_cols,
  show_colnames    = FALSE,
  main             = "RNA • GSVA Hallmarks (Top variable)"
)

```

```{r}
run_contrast <- function(L, label, keep_levels=NULL){
  if(!label %in% names(meta)) return(invisible(NULL))
  y <- meta[[label]]
  if(!is.null(keep_levels)) y[!y %in% keep_levels] <- NA
  ok <- which(!is.na(y)); y <- droplevels(factor(y[ok]))
  if(length(levels(y))!=2 || min(table(y))<20) return(invisible(NULL))
  m <- mat_scaled[[L]][, ok, drop=FALSE]
  tt <- run_limma(m, y)
  nm <- paste0("DE_", toupper(L), "_", label, "_", levels(y)[2], "_vs_", levels(y)[1], ".csv")
  save_tbl(tt, nm); print(volcano(tt, title=paste(toupper(L), "•", label)))
  return(tt)
}
# أمثلة:
res_stage_prot  <- run_contrast("proteome", "stage_bin", c("Early","Late"))
res_egfr_phosph <- run_contrast("phospho",  "egfr_classic_vs_other", c("Classic","NonClassic"))

```

```{r}
tt_path <- function(scores, g=group){
  keep <- !is.na(g); sc <- scores[, keep, drop=FALSE]; g <- droplevels(g[keep])
  p <- apply(sc, 1, function(x) t.test(x[g=="Tumor"], x[g=="NAT"])$p.value)
  d <- apply(sc, 1, function(x) mean(x[g=="Tumor"]) - mean(x[g=="NAT"]))
  data.frame(pathway=rownames(sc), delta=d, fdr=p.adjust(p,"BH"))
}
res_h_rna <- tt_path(rna_gsva_h, group)
knitr::kable(head(res_h_rna[order(res_h_rna$fdr),], 15),
             caption="Top RNA Hallmarks (Tumor vs NAT)")

```

```{r}
count_sig <- function(tt, lfc=0.5, fdr=0.05){
  sum(tt$adj.P.Val <= fdr & abs(tt$logFC) >= lfc)
}
```
